name: Free Roam
description: Walk and cycle in any direction on the normal 2D overhead map in Gen 1, 2 and 3, instead of one grid tile at a time. Keys and d-pad give eight directions, a left stick gives a full 360°, and the pace is the game's own, so the bicycle, Gen 3's running shoes and other speed mods carry through. Walls, warps, ledges, boulders, grass, encounters, trainers and scripts all still run on the game's own rules. The camera and view are unchanged.
